Consular help: Consular help will be provided bythe Embassy of Bosnia and Herzegovina in Madrid, Espańa,the Embassy of Bosnia and Herzegovina in Roma or bythe Consulate General in Milano, Italia.
Visa required for the following traveling documentation for BH citizens :
Regular passport NO
Regular biometric passport NO
Service/Official biometric passport NO
Diplomatic biometric passport NO
In case of business travel citizens of Bosnia and Herzegovina are required visas. Visa shell be issued in Budapest.Citizens of the Republic of Cuba are required visas when entering, exiting or travelling through Bosnia and Herzegovina.Visa shall be issued in Ottawa, Canada or in Madrid, Espańa.Citizens of Cuba, holders of diplomatic and official passports, shall be exempt from the obligation to obtain a visa for entry, exit ,transit and stay on the territory of Bosnia and Herzegovina up to 90 days.
